content.title: Topgolf in Talks to Be Sold to Private-Equity Firm Leonard Green
content.summary: Topgolf Callaway Brands  is in talks to sell its Topgolf unit to private-equity firm Leonard Green, according to people familiar with the matter.  The deal would value Topgolf, which operates recreational driving ranges, at about $1 billion, some of the people said.  Topgolf Callaway had a market value of almost $2 billion as of Thursday’s close.
